response.sql:
WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS station_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
phase_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_phase_avg
  FROM phase_stats
),
kept_phases AS (
  SELECT p.avg_bandusage, p.station_count, m.mean_phase_avg
  FROM phase_stats AS p
  CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m
  WHERE p.avg_bandusage > m.mean_phase_avg
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_bandusage) AS kept_phases_avg_bandusage,
  SUM(station_count) AS total_distinct_station_counts,
  AVG(avg_bandusage - mean_phase_avg) AS avg_excess_over_phase_mean
FROM kept_phases;

assumptions.assumption: A phase with no non-null bandwidth values has a NULL average and is excluded from the mean of phase averages and from the kept phases, consistent with SQL AVG behavior.
